Checked addition returning c = a + b guarded by require(c >= a).
Checked subtraction returning c = a - b guarded by require(b <= a).
Checked multiplication returning c = a * b guarded by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Checked division returning c = a / b guarded by require(b > 0).
Owned constructor that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Second half of two-step ownership transfer; requires msg.sender == newOwner.
Token constructor that initialises metadata, total supply and pre-mines all tokens to the deployer address.
Returns _totalSupply minus the balance of address(0).
Returns the balance of tokenOwner from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd and emits Transfer.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from 'from' to 'to'; updates balances and allowed.
Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves spender and then calls receiveApproval(...) on the spender contract.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts; contract rejects ETH.
onlyOwner function that calls transfer() on an arbitrary token contract to recover tokens.
Caller-controlled address used for balance/allowance keys, ownership checks and forwarded into external calls.
Addition c = a + b inside safeAdd; overflow is reverted by require(c >= a).
Subtraction c = a - b inside safeSub; underflow is reverted by require(b <= a).
Multiplication c = a * b inside safeMul; overflow is reverted by require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
Division c = a / b inside safeDiv; division by zero is reverted by require(b > 0).

External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on a caller-supplied token address; return value not checked.

edges.reason: transfer() calls safeAdd() to credit the recipient balance.
transfer() calls safeSub() to debit the sender balance.
transferFrom() calls safeAdd() for the recipient balance.
transferFrom() calls safeSub() for the sender balance and the allowance.
approveAndCall() hands control to the caller-supplied spender contract via receiveApproval before returning success.
transferAnyERC20Token() performs an external call on an arbitrary token contract.
Constructor writes the symbol state variable.
Constructor writes the name state variable.
Constructor writes the decimals state variable.
Constructor sets _totalSupply to the fixed supply.
Constructor pre-mines the entire supply into balances[deployer].
Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
transferOwnership() writes the pending newOwner.
acceptOwnership() overwrites owner with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership() clears newOwner to address(0).
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply.
totalSupply() reads balances[address(0)].
balanceOf() reads the balances mapping.
transfer() reads balances[msg.sender] and balances[to].
transfer() writes the updated balances entries.
approve() reads the allowed mapping before overwriting it.
approve() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom() reads allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom() decrements the allowance in the allowed mapping.
transferFrom() updates balances for both from and to.
allowance() reads allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
approveAndCall() reads/overwrites the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall() writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
The onlyOwner gate on transferOwnership compares msg.sender against owner.
Owned constructor derives owner from msg.sender.
onlyOwner requires msg.sender == owner, so caller identity controls the ownership transfer.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner; caller identity authorises the ownership change.
transfer() uses msg.sender as the debited account.
approve() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
transferFrom() uses msg.sender as the spender for the allowance debit.
approveAndCall() uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
onlyOwner gates transferAnyERC20Token on msg.sender == owner.
msg.sender is forwarded as the 'from' argument into the external receiveApproval call.
acceptOwnership() reads newOwner to validate and promote it.
Parameter a is an operand of the unchecked-at-source addition in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition in safeAdd.
The addition result is stored in the local c before the overflow require.
Parameter a is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
Parameter b is an operand of the subtraction in safeSub.
The subtraction result is stored in the local c before the underflow require.
Parameter a is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication in safeMul.
The multiplication result is stored in the local c before the overflow require.
Parameter a is the numerator of the division in safeDiv.
Parameter b is the denominator of the division in safeDiv.
The division result is stored in the local c after the zero-divisor require.
transferOwnership() writes the _newOwner parameter into newOwner.
The _newOwner parameter becomes the pending newOwner state variable.
tokenOwner indexes the balances mapping in balanceOf().
The 'to' parameter is the recipient key written by transfer().
The tokens parameter is the amount moved by transfer().
The tokens amount is passed into safeSub() by transfer().
spender is the allowance key written by approve().
tokens is the allowance value written by approve().
'from' is the debited account in transferFrom().
'to' is the credited account in transferFrom().
tokens is the amount moved and allowance-decremented in transferFrom().
tokenOwner indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
spender indexes the allowed mapping in allowance().
spender is granted the allowance in approveAndCall().
tokens is the allowance amount in approveAndCall().
data is the arbitrary payload accepted by approveAndCall().
The caller-chosen spender address is the target of the external receiveApproval call.
tokens is forwarded into the external receiveApproval call.
Attacker-controlled data is forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
tokenAddress selects the external contract in transferAnyERC20Token().
tokens is the amount passed to the external token transfer.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary callee of the external transfer call.
tokens is the amount argument of the external transfer call.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a of safeAdd exists only to feed the checked addition inside safeAdd; fold it into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter b of safeAdd exists only to feed the checked addition inside safeAdd; fold it into the safeAdd function node.
Parameter a of safeSub exists only to feed the checked subtraction inside safeSub; fold it into the safeSub function node.
Parameter b of safeSub exists only to feed the checked subtraction inside safeSub; fold it into the safeSub function node.
Parameter a of safeMul exists only to feed the checked multiplication inside safeMul; fold it into the safeMul function node.
Parameter b of safeMul exists only to feed the checked multiplication inside safeMul; fold it into the safeMul function node.
Parameter a of safeDiv exists only to feed the checked division inside safeDiv; fold it into the safeDiv function node.
Parameter b of safeDiv exists only to feed the checked division inside safeDiv; fold it into the safeDiv function node.
The _newOwner parameter is used exclusively by transferOwnership to set the pending owner; fold it into that function node.
tokenOwner is only used as the balanceOf lookup key; fold it into balanceOf.
The 'to' parameter belongs solely to transfer's balance credit; fold it into transfer.
The tokens parameter belongs solely to transfer's amount logic; fold it into transfer.
spender is only used as the approve allowance key; fold it into approve.
tokens is only used as the approve allowance value; fold it into approve.
'from' is only used as the transferFrom debit account; fold it into transferFrom.
'to' is only used as the transferFrom credit account; fold it into transferFrom.
tokens is only used as the transferFrom amount; fold it into transferFrom.
tokenOwner is only used as the allowance lookup key; fold it into allowance.
spender is only used as the allowance lookup key; fold it into allowance.
spender is the approveAndCall target and allowance key; fold it into approveAndCall.
tokens is the approveAndCall allowance amount; fold it into approveAndCall.
data is the approveAndCall payload, relevant only through the external call it reaches; fold it into approveAndCall.
tokenAddress is the arbitrary external contract selected by transferAnyERC20Token; fold it into that function node.
tokens is the amount forwarded by transferAnyERC20Token; fold it into that function node.
Local c in safeAdd only receives the addition result before the overflow require; merge it into the addition unsafe_operation.
Local c in safeSub only receives the subtraction result before the underflow require; merge it into the subtraction unsafe_operation.
Local c in safeMul only receives the multiplication result before the overflow require; merge it into the multiplication unsafe_operation.
Local c in safeDiv only receives the division result before the zero-divisor require; merge it into the division unsafe_operation.
